name: Chandelier-exit breakout trail (buy strength, ATR-trail) (Pine import)
rationale: Faithful import of the Chandelier Exit trend system (Chuck LeBeau's Chandelier Exit, popularized by Alexander Elder; everget's widely-used open-source 'Chandelier Exit' Pine script: a trailing stop set at Highest-High(22) - ATR(22)*3.0): buy strength as price pushes to the top of its recent range, then ride a volatility-scaled ATR trailing stop anchored to the running high — no fixed profit target, the trail decides the exit. Economic mechanism: entering when price sits at the TOP of its recent channel (a fresh local-high thrust) buys demonstrated upside strength at the point trend-followers expect continuation; the Chandelier ATR trail then widens in volatile tape and tightens after a clean run, locking in trend profit while giving the move room to breathe — the canonical 'cut losses by volatility, let winners run' exit. This is structurally DISTINCT from the Supertrend import (which enters on a trend-STATE: positive ret_Nd + an ADX floor, with a fitted-fraction trail) and from the Turtle import (which enters on a long-lookback Donchian breakout and exits at the opposite channel LOW): here the ENTRY is range_position high (price at the channel ceiling = the LeBeau 'highest high' anchor) and the EXIT is a pure ATR runner_trail (exit.plan.runner_trail) armed after a first partial take, with break-even — the defining Chandelier structure. Translation losses (noted, not fabricated): (1) the literal Chandelier line Highest-High(22) - ATR(22)*3.0 is not a single registry feature — entry uses range_position (price near its channel top, the 'highest high' proximity read) and the exit uses a fitted runner_trail fraction in place of the ATR*3.0 distance (the Finder fits the multiple-equivalent; no magic number); (2) the literal lookback 22 and multiplier 3.0 become fitted lookbacks/fractions; (3) Chandelier flips long/short only after a decisive crossover — we take the long leg only (spot), so the flip-to-short half is dropped. Honest prior: ATR-trailing-stop trend systems (Chandelier/Supertrend family) are the most-cloned crypto trend templates; net of ~20bps round-trip on spot they usually reduce to fee-eaten breakout-momentum — expected a powered fail that maps the buy-strength-and-trail surface; the Gate disposes. Disconfirmer: a wide catastrophic stop_loss plus a time-stop bound a breakout that immediately reverts (the ATR trail's failure mode); range_position is the entry, the runner_trail is the real exit, so a trend that never extends past TP1 is closed by the trail at break-even.
catalyst: price pushes to the top of its recent channel (fresh local-high thrust) — Chandelier long
